responsibility: Declares the convenience wrapper interface for host C library features used by GNU Modula-2, including time string creation, file metadata queries, random values, username and UID/GID lookup, sign-bit tests, and floating-point finiteness helpers. This header is the public utility layer above the raw libc/libm wrappers.
same_name_distinction: This is the declaration header for the Gwrapc pair: it exposes the public utility wrapper prototypes, including some API surface such as fileinode/isfinite variants, while gcc/m2/pge-boot/Gwrapc.cc contains the concrete helper implementations and module lifecycle stubs.
